productionChanges: Managed act drift affects only managed workers, respecting explicit external overrides.
Source-compatible status reasons identify missing build metadata, last reported build, queued/halted rollout, configured window and precise act gaps.
Rollback/deadline failures identify the node and preserve source diagnostic phrases.
Agent failure reports halt only an active entry, with node-prefixed rollout reason; cancel/report refresh public node update state before returning.
Root restored settings rejection when autoUpdate is window without updateWindow.

limits: Deterministic archive members contain architecture headers and are never executed by the new tests.
Update-only and normal offer control tests cover all four target identities/digests in-process; the --now bridge and settings guard also use actual loopback TLS/WebSockets.
Clock injection proves eight-day drain and deadline/window policy without waiting in real time.

Node runtime/tool management is removed by approved exception: native replacements assert Rust metadata, act-only toolchain and no legacy entry/Node fields. Darwin managed-act offers replace the former unsupported-Darwin empty result.
No claim of mixed-target LAN rollout, Mac act/Docker readiness, Intel Mac runtime, WSL2, signing, launchd or reboot acceptance.
